Tests, 06:57: 
## Why

The original `lamp-voice` case `coordinator::tests::reminder_roundtrip::actual_consumer_ipc_coordinator_and_two_retirements_ack_only_after_whole_completion` failed in the first frozen serial affected gate for Provider observations, on base `e7d0f673d0c4bde4a770b19783d6084a8d935ec3`.

At `coordinator/tests/reminder_roundtrip.rs:338`, its resolution did not match `Some(Resolution::AckConfirmed { .. })`. Earlier assertions established **pending false** and **exactly one Ack request**. The actual resolution was not printed and is unknown. Full gate: **2,262 passed / 2 failed / 13 existing ignores**; the other failure was a separate new socket-test defect, retained and being corrected only in that new test.

[Complete raw first gate, exact commands, source, compiled lists and triage](https://github.com/autonomous-ai/lampOS/blob/4165c3b76e71503494a67e84d28fbc200d69fe83/lampOS/docs/verification/provider-observation-first-gate-20261016/README.md).

The original fixture SHA-256 is `f2259a3446933ba7193c95829e6ab092881b828be9d458c79cf6e3b1463bb684`; raw full log SHA-256 is `f5763e86d785165cd96c9c5d0a697d40d7b8885e3f5cb38a1abff24ba16ff66c`. Rust 1.96.0, Mac debug, locked/offline, serial, shared-host load. No retry.

This fixture authors Provider PCM and drives real coordinator/consumer IPC; it does not start the newly observed Provider worker. Unchanged source narrows the path but does not establish a cause or exclude indirect host timing effects. The exact identity passed once in separate native runs 38822580456 (0.031 s), 38822753449 (0.047 s), 38819671092 (0.030 s), and 38820672032 (0.031 s). Those heads do not include this preparation and are not a fix or qualification for it.

This identity is **outside the frozen original 123** and differs from the consumer reminder case already accepted on #739. It must not be silently included in that exact-case exception.

## Wanted

Eighth / the reminder owner: classify the completion boundary, retain the actual resolution and request/ack progress in a reproducer, then make the responsible test or product path deterministic. Keep the original assertions, timing/freshness bounds and real IPC/store work. No retries or relabelling this failure as passing.

## Hand back

A separate reviewed fix preserving the original identity, with a causal regression, first-failure evidence and applicable local/native gates. Say whether the cause is product behavior or the fixture.

## Most likely wrong

One observed Ack request is not proof of an acknowledged completion. This log does not distinguish pending delivery, reply processing, an unexpected resolution or a budget failure. The older consumer case's budget hypothesis is not a diagnosis of this different case.

Tests, 07:36:

A second independently planned, changed-source complete gate fails this exact original reminder identity: silent-service clock migration, **2,252 passed / one failed / 13 existing ignores**, all 2,266 compiled identities and ignore flags unchanged. The unchanged assertion at line 338 still reports no actual resolution. It fails before the migrated silent-service case passes; that order is preserved in the serial transcript.

[Complete raw gate, exact two-line clock change, source inverse, identity audit and separate once-only workspace build](https://github.com/autonomous-ai/lampOS/blob/bfc122d4e5947b075e6ea25a61039137c206f3cf/lampOS/docs/verification/silent-service-retained-gate-20261016/README.md). Original reminder source SHA remains `f2259a3446933ba7193c95829e6ab092881b828be9d458c79cf6e3b1463bb684`; raw full log SHA `a3a71700d69ac126b755e0c0002b9ab4fcc8515e069c5c54ac31c3dc52886516`. No failure-specific retry or accepted-exception claim.

Static inspection shows one host deadline spans Get, ledger planning/fsync and Ack exchange, while the observed Ack request precedes its reply; the failure log does not identify which completion boundary lost evidence. Eighth / the reminder owner: please classify this exact identity or retain actual resolution plus Get/Ack outcome/timestamps in its diagnostic fix. The later pass in Provider's changed-source gate is retained separately and does not erase these failures or prove a fix.

Tests, 08:20: Two further separate first full gates retain this exact original failure at reminder_roundtrip.rs:338: Audio **2,296 PASS / 1 FAIL / 15 existing ignores** and current Provider observations **2,407 / 1 / 13**. All nine Audio and twenty Provider additions pass; fmt, strict affected-package Clippy and workspace builds pass. Neither local gate is green or being treated as an accepted exception.

[Unedited logs, compiled identity audits and source comparison](https://github.com/autonomous-ai/lampOS/blob/1fa7127693002f93021a1afb512e6509f8d1c413/lampOS/docs/verification/reminder-retained-gates-20261016/README.md). The original reminder file is byte-exact to clean e5aa and the earlier two failing gates. Pending=false and one captured Ack request precede the assertion; actual resolution and per-hop timing remain unprinted. The unchanged 250 ms recovery budget includes Get, durable Ack-plan commit and Ack exchange, but timeout/fsync/parse causation is unproved. These are four separate failing gates, not retries. No original assertion, bound or production behavior changed. Eighth retains diagnosis/coordination; the preparations remain unpublished pending disposition and their own native qualification.
